purpose: Targeted A/B for Order 100 hypothesis 1 of 3: remove the generic OCR bias for visual-subject classification and direct the model to inspect image screenshots.
change_scope: Preserve all v82 public actions. Add only a reusable visual-routing guardrail: system and file-discovery context state that OCR reads visible text but cannot classify people, objects, scenes, layout, or appearance; image-bearing discovery results recommend desktop.open_path before OCR. The model still chooses every image, action, copy destination, and archive command. No task identity, person name, filename, selected-file list, answer path, golden artifact, evaluator state, or task workflow is available at runtime.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The untouched v82 baseline found all six images and opened their directory, but repeatedly selected image.extract_text_batch for a visual person-identification task. It never inspected individual images, copied a file, created the destination, or produced the archive. The eight-event no-progress window stopped it after 15 steps and 339.717 Agent seconds; the original evaluator returned 0.0 and strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use unrelated street-lamp, bridge, landscape, and weather-photo review examples. They verify that image discovery recommends opening screenshots before OCR and that both the result context and system prompt truthfully distinguish visual classification from text extraction. No Order 100 task ID, person name, supplied filename, selected-file list, output folder, answer path, golden artifact, or evaluator state appears in active runtime code or tests.

implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 65 passed; covers compact Adapter result context, unrelated visual-subject routing, system prompt behavior, and the complete Multi-Apps catalog surface.

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this hypothesis-1 A/B and do not rerun it unchanged. Diagnose the trace, then use at most two further materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three hypotheses fail, mark Order 100 task_blocked and immediately advance to Order 101.
